claims.evidence: The report only shows a boxed PS5 game case for “God of War Ragnarök” (front artwork, PS logo, PEGI 18). It does not show disc presence/condition or whether it was tested.

risks.risk: Disc may be missing or not included
risks.proof: A clear photo/clip showing the inside of the case (tray) and/or the disc itself.
risks.if_unproven: Price as case-only / disc not confirmed (worst case: no disc).

risks.risk: Disc condition may be poor (scratches, heavy marks, unreadable)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the disc surface (both sides) under light, plus a short test video showing the game launching.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested (worst case: may not run).

risks.risk: Case completeness may be incomplete (missing inserts/manuals/back cover damage)
risks.proof: Photos of the back cover and all inserts/manuals (if any), and a check that the case is complete.

risks.risk: Region/edition and language may not match expectations (import vs local, language availability)
risks.proof: A photo of the back/inside text showing region/edition details and supported languages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard/unknown edition (worst case: may have limited language/compatibility).

risks.risk: No proof of purchase/warranty; authenticity risk for a boxed copy
risks.proof: Receipt/warranty (if any) or a photo of the disc label/serial details that match the box.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no warranty/proof (worst case: authenticity not confirmed).

proof_requests: Photo/clip confirming whether the disc is included (open case showing tray + disc).
Close-up photos of the disc surface (both sides) in good lighting.
Short video of the game being installed/launching on a PS5 (or proof it runs).
Photos of the back cover and any inserts/manuals to confirm completeness.
Photo of region/edition and language details from the box/back.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a boxed PS5 game case for God of War Ragnarök (PEGI 18, PS branding). However, disc inclusion/condition and testing are not shown, so it should be priced at the worst case until proof is provided.
